summary: Iteration 7 backend-only verification of the 3 applied improvements in live_arb_monitor.py. Created /app/backend/tests/test_arb_unwind_fees.py (10 new tests) using a fake LiveTrader/FakeDB harness so _evaluate_pair and _scan_once run for real (no network; Jupiter DNS is blocked in sandbox). Verified: (1) UNWIND — leg2 failure triggers exactly ONE retry (3rd execute_swap call, same mid->start direction and leg1_actual_out amount) after a 2s sleep; when the retry succeeds the trade is recorded as type 'live_auto_arb' with leg2.signature = unwind signature, unwind_attempted=True, unwind_succeeded=True; when the retry also fails the doc is type 'live_auto_arb_stuck', success=False, unwind_succeeded=False. leg1 failure path does NOT trigger an unwind and writes no trade doc. (2) FEES — new fields fees_deducted_usd (float), unwind_attempted/unwind_succeeded (bool), jito_tip_lamports (int, leg1+leg2 sum) exist on the doc; fee math verified numerically: (50000 tips + 10000 gas)/1e9 * 150 = 0.009 USD and pnl_usd = round(realized - start - fee, 6) matched exactly, and risk.record_trade received the fee-deducted PnL. (3) last_decision — _scan_once now assigns self.last_decision on the 'live_trader not ready' skip (verified by calling _scan_once on an instance with lt.ready=False: verdict='skipped', reason contains 'not ready', decision persisted, no trade doc). API: seeded live_auto_arb_stuck (stuck_sig_x) is excluded from GET /api/live/trades and from GET /api/live/summary today aggregates, while live_auto_arb (normal_sig_y) appears with fees_deducted_usd intact and total_jito_tips_sol correctly reflecting 40000 lamports; both seeds cleaned up and removal re-verified. Full regression suite: 189/189 PASS (179 prior + 10 new).

minor.issue: Unwind retry does not verify whether the failed leg2 transaction actually landed on-chain (failure may be a timeout/confirmation error). Retrying blindly can attempt a second sell of tokens already sold, wasting fees or producing an unintended swap. Consider confirming the leg2 signature (if present) before retrying.

When the unwind also fails, the tip lamports spent on the unwind attempt are dropped (total_tip_lamports uses leg2_result which is still the failed leg2 dict), so fees_deducted_usd under-reports the true cost of stuck trades.

Stuck trades still record realized_final=0, so PnL is booked as -100% of the notional (-$1.0015 for a $1 trade) even though the wallet still holds the mid token. This over-penalises risk.record_trade / daily-loss breaker. Value the retained mid-token position instead.

live_auto_arb_stuck trades are (correctly) excluded from normal trade lists/summary, but NO endpoint surfaces them, so a user has zero visibility that the wallet is stuck mid-token. Add a stuck-positions field to /api/live/auto_arb/status or a dedicated endpoint.
total_fired is incremented for stuck trades too, so trades_fired includes half-completed round trips without any counter for stuck ones.

Carried over from iteration 6 and still open: hardcoded SOL=150.0 / JUP=0.5 prices drive both sizing and the new fee_usd/PnL conversion; the arb_decisions cap still does count_documents + per-doc deletes each cycle; start() after stop() cannot restart the loop.

action_items: Confirm the leg2 signature status (or require an explicit non-landed error) before issuing the unwind retry to avoid a duplicate sell.
Include unwind-attempt tip lamports in total_tip_lamports/fees_deducted_usd when the unwind fails.
Value the retained mid-token when recording PnL for live_auto_arb_stuck instead of assuming a total loss.
Expose stuck positions (count/latest) on /api/live/auto_arb/status so the user can see a mid-token exposure.
critical_code_review_comments: The unwind retry reuses leg1_actual_out unconditionally; if the token balance changed (partial fill or landed-but-unconfirmed leg2) the retry will fail or oversell. Read the actual mid-token account balance before retrying.
Only one retry with a fixed 2s sleep; for a real stuck position an escalating retry/alert path (or a manual unwind endpoint) is needed.

server.py is 1211 lines — split live-trading/auto-arb endpoints into a router module; the ['live_manual_swap','live_auto_arb'] type filter is duplicated in /api/live/trades and /api/live/summary and should be a shared constant so a future type is not missed in one place.
seed_data_creation: Temporary db.trades docs (_test_marker=TEST_ITER7: stuck_sig_x, normal_sig_y) — deleted and verified removed. Monitor unit tests used an in-memory FakeDB, no Mongo writes.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (no auth in this app; not required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-6 improvements are implemented and verified. New harness in tests/test_arb_unwind_fees.py (FakeTrader/FakeJupiter/FakeDB + _make_monitor) lets you execute _evaluate_pair/_scan_once without network — reuse it for any further monitor logic. Run pytest with -p no:anchorpy from /app/backend. AUTO_ARB_ENABLED remains unset so the monitor never runs and last_decision stays null on the live status endpoint (expected). Open items are all minor/robustness (see backend_issues.minor).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects reproduced in this iteration; all listed items are robustness gaps found by executing the new code paths with mocked leg results and by static review.
